questions.question: Accept LEGACY_UNSEALED_PUBLICATION/COMPATIBILITY_MODE (R005-2/R006-4: default quiet-interval result-arrival inference, no sealed manifest by default) as sufficient for M7 sign-off, or block M7 pending a dedicated sealed-transport-contract wave?
questions.basis: tier2_safe_to_assume_default (worst case: one wasted, cheaply re-run regression)

grounding_evidence.summary: R005-2/R006-4: default AUTO human-transport result arrival infers completion from a bounded quiet interval, not a positive completion proof; a real slow-writer regression demonstrates the characteristic; two independent Codex reviews confirmed it is accurately disclosed and not a new regression.
